about: S01 shot list for hybrid/run-clips.mjs. A shot animates its keyframe (81 frames); a move (33 frames) flies from the previous shot's last frame to the next shot's keyframe (Wan first-last-frame). Keyframes are out/S01/<name>.png from the *.keyframe.txt prompts and the seeds below.

shots.name: open
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. A very slow gentle drift forward through a bright morning sky, no zoom, no cuts. Four tiny floating miniature islands hang among soft clouds and bob very gently up and down; the clouds drift slowly past; a few birds glide far away. Soft morning sunlight. Tilt-shift miniature diorama, calm and full of wonder.

shots.name: m1
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera glides smoothly forward through the soft morning clouds toward one small floating island with a cosy cutaway photo studio on it, and settles on it. One smooth camera move, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: studio
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Slow gentle push-in toward the beanbag, no zoom, no cuts. A tiny cutaway photo studio on a floating island at 8 AM. The newborn baby in a blush-pink wrap sleeps peacefully and stretches one tiny hand; the mother in a cream sweater strokes the baby's head and smiles at the father, who leans in close. The photographer, a woman with a salt-and-pepper bun, glasses and a charcoal gilet, holds her tan camera to her eye and presses the shutter, then checks the back of the camera and smiles. Soft morning light through the window, dust motes floating in the beam, clouds drifting below the island. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels tender and quiet.

shots.name: m2
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera lifts up and away from the small floating studio island, flies smoothly across the sky through soft clouds as the light warms from morning to midday, and glides down to a small floating island of autumn trees with a family on a picnic blanket. One smooth arcing camera move, no cuts, no morphing; two separate islands in the same sky. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: m3
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera lifts up and away from a small floating autumn island, flies smoothly through soft clouds across the sky as the light warms from afternoon to golden hour, and glides down to a small floating island with a pond and a white wedding arch. One smooth arcing camera move, no cuts, no morphing; two separate islands in the same sky. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: lake
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Slow gentle push-in toward the wedding arch, no zoom, no cuts. A tiny lakeside wedding on a floating island at golden hour. The bride with long wavy black hair, a veil and a blush gown and the groom in a light grey suit hold hands under the rose arch, he leans in and kisses her, the guests in the white chairs stand and clap, a few rose petals float down. The photographer, a woman with a salt-and-pepper bun, glasses and a charcoal gilet, holds her tan camera to her eye and presses the shutter. Warm low golden sunlight with glowing rim light, the pond glitters, the willow sways in a light breeze, golden clouds drift below. Crisp, vivid colours and clear contrast throughout, no haze, no fog, no fade, no mist. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels joyful and warm.

shots.name: m4
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera lifts up and away from the small floating wedding island, flies smoothly through the clouds as the golden sky turns to deep blue night with the first stars, and glides down to a small floating island with a wooden deck under warm string lights. One smooth arcing camera move, no cuts, no morphing; two separate islands in the same sky. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: party
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. Slow gentle push-in toward the deck, no zoom, no cuts. A tiny birthday party on a floating island at night under warm string lights. The birthday woman with a short black bob and a sparkly gold dress waves a fizzing sparkler and laughs; her friends dance, raise their glasses and cheer; the candles on the cake flicker; the string lights sway gently and twinkle. The photographer, a woman with a salt-and-pepper bun, glasses and a charcoal gilet, holds her tan camera to her eye and presses the shutter. Deep indigo night sky with stars, violet clouds drifting below. Same faces, same clothes, nothing drifts. Feels fun and alive.

shots.name: m5
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. The camera pulls slowly up and back from the small floating party island, rising into the twilight sky until four small glowing floating islands are all in view among violet clouds. One smooth pull-back, no cuts, no morphing. Tilt-shift miniature diorama.

shots.name: finale
shots.prompt: Continuous single take. A very slow gentle pull-back, no zoom, no cuts. Four tiny floating islands glow in a twilight sky above violet clouds, their tiny warm lights twinkling: a studio window, a lantern, fairy lights on a wedding arch, string lights at a party. The islands bob very gently, the clouds drift slowly, stars appear. Feels peaceful, a full day well spent.
